scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && npm run dev -w @digvation/docs
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build -w @digvation/docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @digvation-labs/ui && npm run build:ui && npm run typecheck -w @digvation/docs
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run preview -w @digvation/docs
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release:verify: npm ci && npm run validate && npm run pack:ui
